title: The most common feedback I got was "doesn't work on phones", so I rebuilt Overswing for mobile. Looking for Android testers
author: br1ckface
selftext:
When I posted Overswing before, the most common feedback I got was no mobile support. So I built a new version made for phones.



How it was made: the game code, tests and tools with Claude Code; the key art, icon and store art generated from reference images; sound effects from ElevenLabs. Happy to answer questions about any of it.



It's in Google Play's closed test, which needs 12+ testers for 14 days. Join for free at [playoverswing.com](http://playoverswing.com)



Join the group, then open the test link and install with your Play Store's Google account. iPhone version coming later. Feedback very welcome.
